dsbr.config.screen.title: DSBR Config
dsbr.config.requirement.normal_render_mo: This option is inactive because the Normal Dragon Renderer is set to Dragon Survival Original.
dsbr.config.general.normal_render_mode.t: Switches how the regular dragon form is rendered.
dsbr.config.general.special_animation_mo: Switches how abilities, emotes and item-use animations are rendered.
dsbr.config.general.armor_render_mode.to: Switches whether armor appearance changes fall back to Dragon Survival's original renderer or stay on the Bedrock renderer with an armor overlay.
dsbr.config.general.held_item_render_mod: Switches whether held items follow Dragon Survival's original renderItemsInMouth logic or are forced onto the jaw bones or side hand bones.
dsbr.config.general.render_head_in_first: Controls whether the dragon head stays visible in first-person view.
dsbr.config.general.first_person_model_o: Additional X offset applied to first-person dragon rendering.
Additional Y offset applied to first-person dragon rendering.
Additional Z offset applied to first-person dragon rendering.
dsbr.config.general.animation_speed_mult: Applies an extra multiplier after the Dragon Survival-compatible animation speed calculation. 1.0 matches the original speed.
dsbr.config.general.fallback_to_gecko_fo: When enabled, abilities, emotes and item-use animations fall back to Dragon Survival's original GeckoLib renderer.
